# telnyx_storage_bucket_ssl_certificate (Data Source)

The SSL certificate a storage bucket serves on its custom domain.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_name` (String) The bucket name id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Time when SSL certificate was uploaded
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the SSL certificate
- `issued_by` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--issued_by))
- `issued_to` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--issued_to))
- `valid_from` (String) The time the certificate is valid from
- `valid_to` (String) The time the certificate is valid to

<a id="nestedatt--issued_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `issued_by`

Read-Only:

- `common_name` (String) The common name of the entity the certificate was issued by
- `organization` (String) The organization the certificate was issued by
- `organization_unit` (String) The organizational unit the certificate was issued by


<a id="nestedatt--issued_to"></a>
### Nested Schema for `issued_to`

Read-Only:

- `common_name` (String) The common name of the entity the certificate was issued to
- `organization` (String) The organization the certificate was issued to
- `organization_unit` (String) The organizational unit the certificate was issued to
